summary: Iteration 2: tested i18n (?lang), Build Planner, Damage Calculator, Detail->Build, Build->Calc. Backend 50/51 pytest pass (new file test_i18n_api.py + existing test_guide_api.py). Frontend: language switch EN/ES refetches with lang param and translates cards, detail description and skill names/descriptions, dashboard, global search ('armor' EN -> 7 armors). Build: 13 slots, slot-type filtering (armadura 25, amuleto_espada 3, extra_2 excludes extra_1 pick 17->16), totals/cost math verified against data (cost 1850, stats summed correctly), localStorage persistence, remove, clear. Detail modal add-to-build routes to correct slot with toast (extra_1 then extra_2, Espada amulet -> amuleto_espada), not shown on bosses. Calculator: Ichigo effDef 22 / effRes 12.5% / red 18.0% / HP 900k; ALUCARD 1200 -> 860 dmg, 1047 hits (with form), 698 hits without form (600k); bonus 5 -> 903/997 (correct); ranking 31 bosses sorted asc, click selects boss; sword mode adds 'Ataque básico' row with correct math; build-test-calc-button -> /calc?build=1 applies tecnica + bonus 5; calc-use-build-button in sword mode applies sword. Mobile 390px: no overflow on /build and /calc. One real bug: long descriptions not translated in list/search/dashboard summaries.

minor.issue: guide_data.summary() truncates descricao to 220 chars BEFORE server.tr() translates; the truncated string is not a key in translations.json, so every item with description >220 chars stays in Portuguese on cards/search/dashboard (30 items: 21 tecnicas e.g. goro_goro_enel, 1 espada, 5 equipamentos, 3 raids). Detail endpoint is fine (full text). Fix: translate the item first then summarise, e.g. in server.py use summary(tr(i, lang), ...) / or truncate after translation.
No lang param declared, so ?lang=fr isn't rejected with 422 like the other endpoints (it returns only tipos, which stay Portuguese on purpose, so low impact).

ui_bugs.issue: Long descriptions show in Portuguese because of the backend truncation bug above

issues: danoTecnica (e.g. 1200) shares one bar scale with small stats (5-23), so the other bars are almost invisible. Show dano stats separately or scale each bar on its own.
Skill kv/tag values such as 'aviso: Ichigo combina...' (telegraphed attacks) are not translated; only nome/descricao/text/title are.

action_items: Fix summary truncation vs translation order (translate before truncating descricao to 220) so list/search/dashboard descriptions translate for all 30 long-description items
Optional: add lang param to /api/categories for consistency
Optional: give stat bars in build totals their own scale so damage doesn't flatten the rest
critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_items q-filter: `tr(i['nome'] and {'nome': i['nome']}, lang)['nome']` breaks with TypeError if nome is ever falsy (tr(None) returns None). Use tr({'nome': i['nome'] or ''}, lang).
build.js useBuild refetches 4 full category lists on every page that uses it (Build + Calc); fine for current data size
calc.js matches the bot formula exactly; resistencia arrives as a percent (25.0) and is divided by 100. 0 -> 0.05 default, same as the bot's (res||0.05)
build-total-cost testid shares the build-total-* prefix used for stat rows; selectors that use ^= also match cost
seed_data_creation: none (build state only in browser localStorage)
